name: Nam
description: Personal notes and writing. A static Markdown blog. Public MCP read tools; writes open draft GitHub pull requests. In-page WebMCP tools for browser agents.

webmcp.notes: Progressive enhancement. Register tools when WebMCP is available (Chrome origin trial / local flag). Read-only; writes stay on remote MCP.

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Fetch published Markdown by slug, path, or URL.

tools.name: list_authors
tools.description: List authors from .authors.yml, including GitHub name, avatar, and profile URL.

tools.name: validate_post
tools.description: Dry-run frontmatter and excerpt validation. No GitHub write.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a draft post and open a GitHub pull request. Always draft: true. New authors may be GitHub usernames; their profile is written to .authors.yml.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Update a post on a branch and open a pull request. draft: false requires posts:publish.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search over published pages. Returns title, url, and snippet.

tools.name: get_current_page
tools.description: Title, URL, description, and main text of the open tab.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate this tab to a same-origin URL, path, or post slug.

tools.name: list_recent_posts
tools.description: Recent posts from the created RSS feed.

rate_limits.note: Machine-readable errors use code, message, retryable, retry_after. WebMCP tools run in the page and inherit normal browser fetch limits.
